name: Paddle Billing
description: Merchant of record payments with Paddle — handles global tax compliance, subscriptions, and checkout.

requiredSecrets.name: PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
requiredSecrets.reason: Webhook signature secret for verifying event payloads

postInstallNotes:
1. Paddle is a merchant of record — they handle VAT/tax globally so you don't have to.
2. Use sandbox mode during development; set `NODE_ENV=production` when going live.
3. Include the Paddle.js script and use `PADDLE_CLIENT_TOKEN` on the frontend for overlay checkout.
